outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed in frame 0 (left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle through frames 30–100, then closes its fingers around the handle in frames 101–108 (wrist_image). Frames 130–153 show the drawer sliding outward, with its side and the opening behind its front visibly exposed (image and left_ego_image). It remains open as the gripper releases in frames 164–172 (wrist_image and left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, unintended object displacement, or other side effect is visible.
